$comment: Xahau Standards (XAS) index — source of truth for the /xas page. Rendered at build time by src/components/XahauStandards.astro; validated by src/schemas/xas.ts. Nothing is fetched from GitHub, so what you write here is exactly what the site shows. To add a proposal: copy an entry, set `discussion` to the number on github.com/Xahau/xahaud/discussions, and write `title`/`summary` yourself. When the GitHub title is wrong or inconsistent, keep the real one in `sourceTitle`, put the corrected one in `title`/`code`, and say why in `note`. Use `hidden: true` to pull an entry off the page without deleting it. Remember to bump `meta.updated`.

en.title: Xahau Standards (XAS)
en.description: Standards and protocol features proposed and discussed openly by the Xahau community

labels.title: Xahau Standards
labels.subtitle: Proposals for protocol features and interface conventions, written and debated in the open
labels.statement: A Xahau Standard (XAS) starts as a public proposal on GitHub. Anyone can open one, anyone can argue with it, and nothing here is settled until the network says so. This page is an index of those proposals — the discussion itself lives on GitHub, where you can read every argument and add your own.
labels.ctaNote: Proposals are opened in the Feature Ideas / Discussions category of the xahaud repository.
labels.contribute: Have an idea for a standard? Open a discussion and make the case for it.

draft.label: Draft
draft.blurb: Written up as a numbered standard and open for comment

discussion.label: Open ideas
discussion.blurb: Raised for discussion, not yet written up as a numbered standard

accepted.label: Accepted
accepted.blurb: Agreed as a standard, awaiting implementation

rejected.label: Withdrawn
rejected.blurb: Closed without adoption — kept here for the record

items.title: Hook Type Codes for Interface
items.sourceTitle: XAS-010d: Hook Type Codes for Interface
items.summary: Defines a single-byte type code registry for Hook interface standards. The lower half (0x00–0x7F) mirrors existing serialization codes, while the upper half (0x80–0xFF) is reserved for Hook-specific types such as XFL floating-point values.
items.author: tequdev

items.title: Hook State Interface
items.note: Opened on GitHub with an XLS- prefix; listed here in the XAS series it belongs to.
items.summary: Sets a convention for Hooks to publish their state layout as machine-readable typed key/value interfaces through HookParameters, so clients can construct and decode Hook State entries without out-of-band knowledge of the Hook.
items.author: tequdev

items.title: Hook Parameter Signature Interface
items.summary: A naming convention that encodes type information and parameter indices into Hook parameter names, letting wallets and explorers render invocation forms automatically instead of relying on external documentation.
items.author: tequdev

items.title: On-Ledger NFT Metadata via Remarks
items.sourceTitle: XAS-007d: On-Ledger NFT Metadata via Remarks (`xahau-nft-remark/v1`)
items.summary: Stores complete NFT metadata, images included, directly on the ledger using remarks instead of off-ledger servers. Covers fragment assembly, binary content with integrity verification, mutable metadata overlays and third-party endorsements.
items.author: zgrguric

items.title: URITokenBroker
items.summary: Adds an optional BrokerAccount field to URITokenBuy so broker-mediated sales settle atomically: the seller receives exactly the listed price and the broker receives the spread, without a trusted intermediary holding funds.
items.author: tequdev

items.title: ClaimReward Hook Interface
items.summary: A standard Hook interface for IOU and TrustLine reward programs, specifying the required parameters (CLAIM_ISS, CLAIM_CUR, PAID_ISS, PAID_CUR) and transaction rules so clients can discover and process claims consistently.
items.author: tequdev

items.title: Withdraw Authorization
items.summary: Sender-side controls over outgoing payments: a WithdrawPreauth whitelist, a WithdrawNoauth blacklist and a WithdrawSetauth delegated provider list, mirroring the receiver-side DepositPreauth framework.
items.author: Handy4ndy

items.title: Deposit Authorization
items.summary: Receiver-side controls over incoming payments: a DepositNoauth blacklist and DepositSetauth provider-list subscriptions, complementing the existing DepositPreauth whitelist with deny-list and inherited trust-list behaviour.
items.author: Handy4ndy

items.title: Native Treasury Amendment
items.note: Numbered XAS-2d on GitHub; zero-padded here to match the rest of the series.
items.summary: Lets an account lock XAH while continuing to earn balance adjustment rewards, with flexible distribution to multiple recipients — addressing limitations of the existing escrow mechanism.
items.author: dazzlingxrpl

items.title: PWA boot-blob — a layer-1, verifiable UI for Hooks
items.sourceTitle: PWA boot-blob — a layer-1, verifiable UI for Hooks
items.summary: A small on-chain bootloader that verifies and loads a larger UI application from off-chain sources before it runs, rooting the security of a Hook's interface in the ledger rather than in a web host.
items.author: Hugegreencandle

items.title: Native Transfer Fees for URITokens
items.summary: Optional, immutable transfer-fee fields on URITokens, letting creators set a fee on secondary sales and nominate the wallet that receives it automatically.
items.author: Cbot-XRPL
